property_summary: For any input _val, after calling SetMinSum(_val) on the correct contract C the public getter MinSum equals the supplied _val; the mutant that assigns MinSum = MinSum breaks this by leaving MinSum unchanged for some _val (when MinSum initially differs from _val).
change_summary: Invert the assignment so MinSum is set to the previous value of MinSum (no change) instead of _val, causing no observable change in MinSum after call.
